Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293224 (Microtubule-associated protein tau). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Require exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Include canonical SMILES via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
